title: CDEDI/small-business demonstration planned for Jan 8
reason: Announcement only; Malawi24’s Jan 9 search-result report says the City Council did not consent and the Jan 8 march did not proceed.
notes: The plan was shifted first to Jan 13; do not count the announced date as a gathering.

title: CDEDI/small-business demonstration planned for Jan 13
reason: Postponed due to national mourning and rescheduled for Jan 19; no Jan 13 gathering is reported.
notes: Jan 9 item moved the plan from Jan 8 to Jan 13; on Jan 13 CDEDI postponed it due to national mourning and rescheduled for Jan 19. The actual Jan 19 march is retained as MW202101-E001, not duplicated.

title: Health workers’ threatened future strike
reason: The Jan 18 article reports a press briefing and threat of future strike by Mar 1, not an executed strike or public assembly.
notes: Keep the policy demands as contextual information only.

title: Water boards workers’ threatened shutdown/strike
reason: The report documents a request for government intervention and discussion of a possible future strike, not an executed public gathering.
notes: Private/sector labor correspondence alone is not evidence of a mass public action.

title: Blantyre minibus drivers’ Jan 15 statement on transport rules
reason: The opened report describes an association statement/interview criticizing rules and prices; it does not report a public gathering.
notes: Separate from the actual Jan 26 protest candidate.
